periods.label: Open season, catch and release only

candidates.summary: The Snake Range High Lakes are open to fishing year-round, catch and release only.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — White Pine County, Snake Range High Lakes

parameters.counting_rule: No trout may be kept; all trout caught must be released immediately.

candidates.summary: Zero trout may be kept at the Snake Range High Lakes; all trout must be caught and released.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — White Pine County, Snake Range High Lakes
candidates.summary: Fishing is permitted any hour of the day or night at the Snake Range High Lakes.

parameters.note: This gear restriction protects the native Bonneville cutthroat trout population and ongoing NPS/NDOW restoration work in the Snake Range high-elevation lakes (Great Basin National Park).

candidates.summary: Only artificial lures with a single barbless hook may be used at the Snake Range High Lakes; no bait fishing.

parameters.note: Standard Nevada resident/nonresident fishing license required for anglers 12 and older.

candidates.summary: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers age 12 and older; no license required under age 12.
